newsitem.title: ITALY: Pisa air cargo to hit 40,000 tonnes a year by 2010.
newsitem.headline: Pisa air cargo to hit 40,000 tonnes a year by 2010.

text.p: Pisa airport aims to be handling 40,000 tonnes of cargo and over two million passengers by the year 2010, the airport management company told journalists.
The plan presented at the press conference was a "future projection" and no indication was given as to its investment cost.
Cargo facilities at Pisa airport include a fully automated cargo centre of 1,500 sq.m. with 52 pallet positions and a heating system for holding live stock and a import/export warehouse of 900 sq m.
Pisa airport handled 3,307 tonnes of cargo traffic for January to May 1997 and 374,463 passengers for the same period. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
